reference.purpose: Independent current cadastral reference, not historical control correspondences. No refitting, matched controls or geographic delivery yet.

qualitative_review: Current magenta cadastral outlines broadly follow multiple historical hatched buildings west of Chemin du Molard and along Rue du Borgeaud. Visible offsets remain; no independently measured error bound is established.
Many current footprints inside B1/B2/C1 intersect the 2010 prospective construction areas; these are post-plan structures, not usable historical registration controls.
The PDF contains elevation diagrams below the plan. Diagnostic crops stop at PDF y=920 to exclude these non-plan drawings.
coordinate_method: Official ArcGIS output explicitly requested EPSG:21781; inverse of frozen PR127 affine maps these coordinates to PDF. No LV95 conversion or affine refitting.
